# **🥷NEW FREE ASSASSINS UPDATE**🥷
Available now for all players. Don’t get killed!

3 assassins can visit you!
- Survive poison, bombs, stalkers & claim their deadly weapons. 
- Knock enemies down with headshots or blunt force.
- 13 new weapons to unleash: explosives, bazookas, bow & arrows & even set enemies ablaze with torches. 
- Inventory: 13 foods, 20 weapons, 19 outfits & more to collect.

[media]
                                         
# 💬JOIN OUR DISCORD AND BECOME A LAUNCHER!!🗨️

https://discord.gg/TKAhFrUjcq

# 👑 WHO’S THE KING 👑

Sit on the throne, grab your sword, keep your eyes wide open, and decide who gets to enter your kingdom. Every visitor matters… and every mistake could cost you your crown. 👑

[media]

# 🛡️ Protect your people🛡️

Plagues, criminals, traitors, danger is everywhere. Inspect newcomers, heal the sick, and stop threats before they spread like wildfire. 🕵️‍♂️

[media]

# ⚖️ Judge. Decide. Execute. ⚖️

Search suspects, treat the wounded, cut off gangrened limbs, throw criminals into the dungeon… And if justice demands it? Off with their heads 😵‍💫⚔️.

[media]


# 🔥 Avoid the Revolution! 🔥 
The people are angry. Be fair, be smart, or be ruthless - but don’t push them too far…
A bad king doesn’t last long. 💥

[media]

# 🩷 Choose your Queen!  🩷

Ruling alone is boring, why not make one of your visitors your queen? Give her items, maybe she'll react differently!

[media]

Rule wisely… or lose everything. So tell us, Who’s the King? 👀👑
